sources.discoverySeed: Admitted native OpenAPI JSON with /api/notice-exports capability
sources.scopeWindow: YYYY-MM-DD or inclusive YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD; cursor is next completed day
sources.temporalSemantics: Europe/Berlin midnight ranges; days earlier than the admitted snapshot retrieval day only; earliest 2022-12-01; never today/future
sources.rights: held_origin: catalog CC0 publication-policy indexing is not document-level admission; tender attachments excluded

sources.pagination: ITERATION; opaque iterationNextToken; ALL scope; onlyLatestVersions false; timeout or unmatched total stays partial
sources.discoverySeed: Admitted native search response; continuation requires factory tedQuery bound by executor to the original query
sources.initialSearch: procurementTedReferences builds POST resource references from native BT-701 fields, never descriptions/names
sources.rights: held_origin until notice-specific admission; EU notice reuse and website/editorial/attachment rights are distinct

ocds.identity: publisher + ocid identifies procedure; release id is notice version; tender, lot, award, contract and party IDs separately scoped to procedure
ocds.awardRelationshipGate: awards.status exactly active; pending/cancelled retain status but no awarded_to
ocds.ocidEquivalence: No inferred equivalence to eForms UUIDs or TED publication number

eforms.standard: Original UBL eForms XML; exact canonical cbc/cac/ext/efext/efac SDK selectors
eforms.identity: BT-701 notice ID + BT-757 version; BT-04 procedure; documented Lot IDs stay procedure-scoped, while ORG/RES/TEN/CON/TPA technical IDs and references are notice+version scoped and never merged solely through a shared procedure
eforms.awardRelationshipGate: LotResult TenderResultCode selec-w plus explicit LotTender -> TenderingParty -> Tenderer references; every chain field retained as structured evidence
eforms.dates: IssueDate is dispatch, SettledContract AwardDate is award decision, SettledContract IssueDate is contract conclusion; never inferred actual publication. Zone-qualified xsd:date values (YYYY-MM-DDZ or YYYY-MM-DD+01:00) normalize to their validated local calendar day; exact original offset lexeme remains in evidence. Offset range <=14:00; calendar-invalid values hold.
eforms.unsupported: Alternative namespace prefix bindings/multiple extension containers are held rather than loose descendant matching; this is a mapped-field parser, not full SDK validation

csv.standard: RFC4180 original notice.csv plus native 1:n tables; no invented normalized JSON input
csv.identity: noticeIdentifier + noticeVersion foreign key; procedureIdentifier BT-04; documented lot IDs stay procedure-scoped; result/tender/contract identities are notice+version scoped; empty lot key means procedure-level
csv.schemaEvolution: Added columns/tables tolerated; missing identity columns, dangling notice/version references and duplicate notice/version rows held
csv.dates: notice publicationDate is BT-738 preferred publication date, not proof of actual publication
csv.limitations: Unmapped original columns/tables do not become claims; winnerChosen is a status, never a guessed contractor relation

crossFormatVersionIdentity: BT-757 numeric versions canonicalize decimal leading zeros for notice keys (XML/CSV 02 equals TED integer 2), while nativeVersion/raw evidence preserves the original value. Unknown/non-numeric version syntax is held. This applies only to explicit European notice identifiers, never OCDS release IDs.
evidence: Original admitted archive byte hash + member name + JSON pointer/XML selector/CSV row and cells + scalar rawValue + mapping/schema hash; no synthesized prose or model receipt
geography: AGS remains null unless an independent verified geography join is supplied downstream. Scope AGS is never projected onto national notices. NUTS/postcode/city evidence retains performance-location role, not project location or buyer seat.
financialSemantics: Estimated value=plan; OCDS award value=approval only when award.status is exactly active, otherwise none; native tender value has no payment/actual role. Contract dates and notices do not prove paid invoices or constructed/delivered output.
withdrawals: Explicit cancelled/unsuccessful native status retained with notice version; absence from partial page or empty export is not withdrawal/deletion
bounds: Shared readZip: 16 MiB input, 64 MiB expansion, 16 MiB/member, 512 members, expansion ratio 200; CRC, traversal, symlink, encryption rejection; no ZIP64/multidisk; parser input 64 MiB; 10000 OCDS releases and 50000 observations per representation; TED 250 rows max
integration: Register procurementAdapter for both catalog IDs
Admit exact original bytes and policy receipt via shared acquisition owner; unresolved rights stay held upstream
Run parser only in credential-free network-denied executor; no direct parser fetches
Bind POST query/body hash to source representation; factory tedQuery must match admitted continuation response selector
Preserve archive original and member evidence; structured-tables.ts readZip/readCsv dependency supplied by FundingAdapter
Keep typed observations as source assertions; no inference to permit/completion/payment/current validity
fixtureCoverage: zone-qualified XML dates and invalid calendars/offsets
reused notice-local technical IDs across same-procedure notices/versions
no payout/finalization from tender or award
